June: Appreciate the runtime update — filing a few concrete asks for the roadmap doc so PMs and SREs can act quickly:

- What's the recommended microbatch ceiling for interactive chat routes vs bulk jobs, and should product surface a toggle?
- How strict is cache isolation for multi-tenant traffic? Any tenant-safety caveats we should warn about?
- Who owns the kernel canary lifecycle (kickoff, monitor gates, and hard revert authority)?
- One-line telemetry set PMs can screenshot for SLOs?

Marco: Short bullets from runtime leads:
- Microbatch: chat = max_batch 8 (default); ultra-low-latency routes can be 4 with 100ms flush. Bulk/embeddings: 64 default, 128 for A100. We support per-route overrides but they require infra privileges today.

Rashmi: Cache semantics: strict tenant namespacing at key level. We pin session prefixes 2–5min, then fall back to best-effort shared-prefix cache. No cross-tenant leakage possible if you namespace keys correctly; treat cache as performance hint, not truth. Eviction = TTL(30m) + size-LRU.

Olive: Canary ops: runtime eng schedules canaries (typical 5% for 30m). Gates we watch: p95 token-latency, request success rate, memory/oom spikes. Automated fallback routes to a compatible quantized variant after sustained latency breach (30s). Emergency hard-revert is SRE on-call (they can partial-drain + rollback). Normal automated rollback triggers if error rate >0.8% in the canary window.

June: Can someone paste a minimal canary snippet + a link to the staging dashboard? Also, product wants a single dashboard name and exactly three charts to point at leadership.

Marco: Minimal canary snippet to include in the doc:
```
canary:
  traffic_fraction: 0.05
  duration_minutes: 30
  trace_sample_rate: 1.0
  fallback_policy:
    latency_threshold_ms: 500
    consecutive_window_seconds: 30
    fallback_variant: quantized-v1
```

Rashmi: Staging dashboard (histograms + mem traces): https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/staging/runtime-batching.

Olive: PM-friendly dashboard name: "Runtime / Route SLOs" with these three widgets: 1) p50 & p95 token-latency (combined), 2) request success rate (errors/min), 3) cost per 1k tokens. Add model-variant traffic split as a small optional widget for rollouts.

SRE-Bot: Canary created: canary/2378901234 scheduled 2026-06-12T18:00:00Z. Alerts: runtime-canary-latency, runtime-canary-oom, runtime-canary-errors.

June: Thanks — I'll stitch this into the roadmap doc and add an ops checklist. If folks have representative prewarm prompts (1 short convo, 1 long ~1500 tokens, 1 embedding batch), drop them here and we'll bake them into the canary job.

Marco: Short convo: "Summarize this conversation in one sentence." Long: 1500-token repeated policy fragment. Embeddings: 128 small JSON blobs.

June: Perfect — closing follow-up, will ping when notes are live. :white_check_mark:
